assessment.title: Finger Tapping
assessment.description: Tap as regularly as you can for a short period so the app can record your tapping rhythm.
assessment.instructions: Sit comfortably and rest your hand on a table. When the test starts, tap the pad with the finger indicated on screen, at a steady pace that feels natural. Keep tapping until the test finishes on its own.

explanation: Baseline established from 4 comparable session(s): 4 valid and 0 borderline.
